title: Shree Aainath Construction marketing website (responsive single-page)

requirements.summary: Build a responsive multi-section marketing site with clear navigation and English copy for “Shree Aainath Construction”.
acceptanceCriteria: The site title/branding displays “Shree Aainath Construction”.
All visible UI text is in English.
Layout is responsive for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
A top navigation allows smooth scrolling or routing to each major section/page.

file_operations.description: Create the main single-page layout (header + sections) with branding text “Shree Aainath Construction” and responsive structure; include section anchors/ids to support navigation scrolling.

Implement a responsive top navigation that links to each major section (Home, About, Services, Projects, Contact) and supports keyboard navigation. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button) where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure the app renders the newly created App component and retains existing providers; confirm the import path resolves correctly after adding frontend/src/App.tsx.
Add baseline responsive styles (including smooth scrolling behavior) and shared layout utilities used across the site; keep all user-facing text in components in English.

requirements.summary: Implement core content structure: Home (hero + CTA), About, Services, Projects gallery, and Contact details + inquiry form UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Home includes a hero area with headline, short description, and at least one call-to-action button (e.g., “Request a Quote”).
About section/page includes a company overview and highlights (e.g., experience, quality, safety).
Services lists at least 4 service cards relevant to a general construction business (generic, non-location-specific wording).
Projects section displays a grid/gallery layout with at least 6 project placeholders (title + short description) and project images (use generated/static assets).
Contact section includes clearly labeled placeholders for phone, email, and address (values can be “TBD” if not provided), plus an inquiry form UI with fields: Name, Phone, Email, Message.

file_operations.description: Create the Home hero section with headline, short value proposition, and at least one CTA button (e.g., “Request a Quote”). Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button) for CTAs; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create the About section with English company overview and highlight bullets (experience, quality, safety) in a responsive layout.

Create the Services section listing at least 4 service cards relevant to a general construction business. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card) for service tiles; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create the Projects portfolio section with a responsive grid/gallery showing 6 project placeholders (title + short description) and static images from frontend/public/assets/generated. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card) for project tiles; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create the Contact section with placeholders for phone/email/address (TBD allowed) and an inquiry form UI with fields Name, Phone, Email, Message. Use shadcn-ui form inputs (e.g., Input, Textarea, Button) for consistent UI; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire all sections (Hero, About, Services, Projects, Contact) into the single-page flow and ensure navigation targets (ids) match the top nav links.

requirements.summary: Define and apply a cohesive construction-themed design system (no blue/purple primary palette).
acceptanceCriteria: A consistent palette is used across components (e.g., charcoal/gray + safety orange + off-white).
Typography is consistent (headings, body text, and button styles).
Buttons, cards, and section separators follow a unified style.
Design looks appropriate for a construction brand (industrial/modern feel).

file_operations.description: Establish the construction-themed palette using CSS variables (charcoal/gray + safety orange + off-white) and define consistent typography/spacing tokens; avoid blue/purple as the primary palette.
Create a shared layout wrapper that standardizes section spacing, max-width/container usage, and consistent section styling (e.g., separators, backgrounds) for an industrial/modern construction feel.

Adopt the shared SiteLayout and apply consistent button/card/section styling across all sections. Use shadcn-ui components where they help enforce consistent styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add and render required generated images as static assets (hero, logo/brand, and projects gallery) from frontend/public/assets/generated.
acceptanceCriteria: All required generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated.
Hero uses the specified hero image (or pattern) as a background or prominent visual.
Branding area uses the specified logo image.
Projects gallery uses the specified project placeholder images without fetching from the backend.

Add the generated hero banner asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/sac-hero.dim_1600x900.png for use in the hero section.

Render the hero image prominently using the static asset frontend/public/assets/generated/sac-hero.dim_1600x900.png (background or primary visual) with meaningful alt text if used as an .

Wire the 6 project tiles to use the static images from frontend/public/assets/generated/sac-project-01.dim_800x600.png through frontend/public/assets/generated/sac-project-06.dim_800x600.png, without any backend fetching.

requirements.summary: Add basic SEO and accessibility essentials (title, meta description, semantic headings, alt text, keyboard navigation).
acceptanceCriteria: Document title includes “Shree Aainath Construction”.
A meta description is present (generic business description is acceptable).
Pages/sections use semantic heading order (H1 then H2/H3).
All images have meaningful alt text.
Navigation and primary actions are usable via keyboard.

file_operations.description: Add a meta description for the business and verify the existing document title includes “Shree Aainath Construction”; keep lang='en' intact.

Ensure semantic heading structure with a single H1 in the hero and appropriate H2/H3 usage for sub-content; ensure CTA is a real button/link and keyboard accessible. Use shadcn-ui Button if applicable; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure semantic headings (H2/H3) and readable, accessible text structure (lists where appropriate) with English copy.
Ensure service cards are keyboard navigable where interactive, use appropriate headings, and maintain consistent alt/aria patterns if icons/images are added.
Add meaningful alt text for each project image and ensure tile interactions (if any) remain keyboard accessible.

Ensure form fields have accessible labels, logical tab order, and keyboard-operable submit action. Use shadcn-ui inputs/buttons if applicable; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
